title: IMPORTANT! MASTERS ATTP 2024!
body_html:
3 days to go until the unprecedented sporting event MASTERS ATTP-2024!

We look forward to welcoming all participants, supporters and table tennis fans at the TOP CUP Academy venue (12/A Bucuriei St., Chișinău) on 23 March 2024, from 09:00.

TOP CUP Academy is the best venue for table tennis competitions in the Republic of Moldova, where guest comfort, safety and quality of service are unmatched in the country.

Everyone attending, without exception, will be offered hot drinks and an assortment of fresh pastries FREE OF CHARGE.

Let’s support our brave masters taking part in the tournament and enjoy their exceptional table tennis!
